title: Modularize cli/appbuilder.js into cli/lib modules
description: Behavior-preserving refactor: extract cohesive modules under cli/lib (e.g. git.js, coordination.js, plan.js, validate.js) and reduce cli/appbuilder.js to a command router that wires them together. Isolate the schema validator as its own module so a future validation upgrade has a clean seam (no dependency added now). The existing test suite must pass unchanged as the proof that behavior is preserved.
acceptance_criteria: cli/appbuilder.js is reduced to a router that delegates to cli/lib modules.
The schema validator lives in its own module (cli/lib/validate.js).
The full existing test suite passes with no changes to the tests.
appbuilder doctor and status behave identically to before the refactor.
